title: Recording: Medley: Rip It Up/Ready Teddy, Stand By Me, Slippin’ And Slidin’ by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon recorded several songs for his Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 23 October 1974.

This was the second recording session involving the whole band of session musicians since Lennon relocated the sessions to New York City. They taped the backing tracks for ‘Medley: Bring It On Home To Me/Send Me Some Lovin”, ‘Stand By Me’, and ‘Slippin’ And Slidin”.
